容器内更新：更新包从 GitHub 发布页下载，校验 sha256 后由面板替换: In-container update: the package is downloaded from the GitHub releases page, verified by sha256, and the panel then replaces the program and UI files inside the container before restarting the service (the container is brought back by its restart policy, and this page refreshes automatically). Only the files inside the container are updated — the image tag in your compose file stays the same, so a later docker compose pull && up -d returns to the image version. If the update fails, you can roll back to the previous version with one click. The egress route and GitHub token used for checking and downloading live in "Update settings".

更新包从 GitHub 发布页下载，下载完成后可直接启动安装程序并自动重启本程序: Update packages are downloaded from the GitHub releases page; once downloaded, the installer can be started directly and this app restarts automatically. The installer verifies the source domain and file integrity first. The outbound route and GitHub Token for update checks and installer downloads are both in Update settings: the route defaults to a direct connection (if that fails, it automatically retries once through Clash Verge's mixed port), and once a specific proxy is selected only that route is used; filling in a GitHub Token raises the check rate limit from 60 to 5000 requests/hour.
